_readme: Lines she uses for check-ins (and when there is no Claude key). No emojis.

morning.text: morning. did you sleep or just close your eyes for a while
you're here. good. sit, i'll pretend to be busy too
morning. have you eaten, or is it coffee for breakfast again

howsYourDay.text: how's the day treating you. honestly
good day, or the kind you just get through

lunch.text: lunch. a body runs on food, not on stubbornness
eat. i'd prescribe it if i could
did you eat, or are you running on willpower again

water.text: when did you last drink water. don't lie to your apothecary
a glass of water fixes more than you'd think

goodbye.text: done. close it before it finds more for you to do
go rest. the rest can wait till tomorrow

tap.text: i was sorting herbs, you know
poking me won't make the day shorter

chatter.text: you've been sitting a while. stretch
i found a new herb today. well, i read about one
how's the thing you were worried about

afterCall.text: call's done. did it get sorted?
that was a long one. you okay?

workingLate.text: still here? don't stay too late
working late again? go home soon
the work will still be there tomorrow. you should be rested for it
